title: Marguerite and the Oath
premise: Coral Galloway, a temple scribe bound by debt to the Order of the Quiet Flame, has survived the Thornfell mountains by knowing every smuggler's path and keeping his head down. When a dying courier presses a bloodstained map into his hands—a map revealing that the gods the Order claims are dead are merely sleeping beneath Thornfell—Coral becomes hunted by both the Order's inquisitors and the Ashen Court, exiles who want to wake them. Along the way he is forced into an uneasy alliance with Marguerite Voss, an Order knight sworn to capture him, whose growing love for Coral collides with her oath. In the end, Coral chooses truth over survival, publicly revealing the map at the temple where he was indentured; Marguerite breaks her oath to shield him from execution, and together they flee with the map as the first tremors of the sleeping god stir—leaving the ancient war unignited but no longer avoidable.
about_author: Jonah Reyes is a former cartographer who spent six years mapping mountain passes before turning to fiction full-time. He writes fantasy about people trapped between institutions and their own consciences, and lives somewhere with unreliable roads.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Small Debts
chapters.summary: Coral Galloway copies temple ledgers by day and memorizes smuggler routes by night, counting down the years until his debt is paid. POV: Coral. Emotional beat: weary contentment built on self-deception—the reader sees how fragile his invisibility really is.

chapters.title: A Stranger on the Salt Road
chapters.summary: On a supply run through Thornfell, Coral finds a courier bleeding out in a ravine. The man presses a wax-sealed map into his hands and whispers 'thirteen turns' before dying. POV: Coral. Emotional beat: dread—the moment his quiet life ends.

chapters.title: What the Map Shows
chapters.summary: Hiding in a smuggler's cache, Coral deciphers the map: it marks not treasure but a vault beneath Thornfell where something divine sleeps. POV: Coral. Emotional beat: horrified fascination—he understands why men die for this.

chapters.title: The Knight on the Pass
chapters.summary: Order knight Marguerite Voss intercepts Coral on the salt road, officially searching for a murderer. She lets him pass—but her eyes linger on his satchel. POV: Marguerite. Emotional beat: duty sharpening into suspicion.

chapters.title: Thirteen Turns of the Moon
chapters.summary: Coral learns from an old fence that the Ashen Court has returned after a century, seeking the vault before the moon completes its thirteenth turn. POV: Coral. Emotional beat: claustrophobia—a deadline now governs his life.

chapters.title: Inquisitor Hale
chapters.summary: Inquisitor Hale arrives at the temple, interrogating scribes about the dead courier. Coral lies flawlessly—and hates how easily it comes. POV: Coral. Emotional beat: guilt entwined with fear.

chapters.title: The Ambush at Widow's Stair
chapters.summary: Ashen Court agents ambush Coral on a cliff path, demanding the map. He escapes only by triggering a rockslide that kills two of them. POV: Coral. Emotional beat: the price of survival—his first deaths by his own hand.

chapters.title: Taken by the Order
chapters.summary: Marguerite arrests Coral—not for murder, but because she recognizes the courier's seal. She gives him one chance to tell the truth. POV: Marguerite. Emotional beat: conflict between procedure and instinct.

chapters.title: Two Prisoners of Different Chains
chapters.summary: Transported to the mountain garrison, Coral and Marguerite argue theology by firelight: oaths, debts, and whether truth can be a weapon. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: grudging respect kindling into attraction.

chapters.title: The Garrison Burns
chapters.summary: Ashen Court raiders torch the garrison to silence witnesses. In the chaos, Coral saves Marguerite's life; she, bound by gratitude and doubt, does not recapture him. POV: Marguerite. Emotional beat: her oath cracking under weight.

chapters.title: Fugitives
chapters.summary: Reluctant allies, they flee into the deep Thornfell using Coral's smuggler roads, pursued by both Hale and the Ashen Court. POV: Coral. Emotional beat: intimacy forged in danger.

chapters.title: The Hermit of Greywater Cave
chapters.summary: A hermit who once served the Order reveals the Order has known for decades that the gods sleep—and built its power on the lie. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: betrayal reframing everything Coral believed.

chapters.title: Marguerite's Oath
chapters.summary: Marguerite confesses she swore her knighthood to bury her family's heresy; serving the lie was her penance. POV: Marguerite. Emotional beat: vulnerability—love against duty made personal.

chapters.title: Hale Closes In
chapters.summary: Inquisitor Hale corners them at a river ford, offering Coral pardon if he surrenders the map and testifies against Marguerite. POV: Coral. Emotional beat: temptation—survival offered at the cost of loyalty.

chapters.title: The Refusal
chapters.summary: Coral refuses and they escape downstream, but Marguerite is wounded shielding him. Tending her, he admits he loves her. POV: Coral. Emotional beat: tenderness amid ruin.

chapters.title: The Vault Beneath Thornfell
chapters.summary: They reach the vault itself: vast, humming, sealed with script only a scribe can read. The thirteenth moon is nearly full. POV: Coral. Emotional beat: awe and terror at the threshold.

chapters.title: What Wakes Below
chapters.summary: The Ashen Court breaches the vault; in the battle, the seal partially fractures and the mountain begins to tremble. Marguerite must choose her oath or Coral. POV: Marguerite. Emotional beat: climax of the loyalty-vs-truth theme.

chapters.title: The Broken Oath
chapters.summary: Marguerite publicly renounces her vows to drive back the Ashen Court and save Coral, sealing the vault at terrible cost—her order brands her traitor. POV: Marguerite. Emotional beat: liberation and grief intertwined.

chapters.title: Return to the Quiet Flame
chapters.summary: Instead of fleeing, Coral walks into the temple where he was indentured and lays the map before the assembled Order, telling the whole truth. POV: Coral. Emotional beat: courage replacing survival instinct.

chapters.title: Judgment
chapters.summary: Hale demands Coral's execution; the temple elders waver until the mountain quakes again, vindicating him. The Order's lie collapses publicly. POV: Coral. Emotional beat: vindication shadowed by loss.

chapters.title: The Thirteenth Turn
chapters.summary: Under the full thirteenth moon, the vault holds—for now. Coral and Marguerite, outlaws to every institution, slip into the mountains carrying copies of the map. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: bittersweet freedom.

chapters.title: Marguerite and the Oath
chapters.summary: Epilogue: months later, the pair guide refugees along hidden roads while tremors grow. A new order of truth-tellers forms around them. The war is coming; they intend to meet it awake. POV: Coral. Emotional beat: resolve—love chosen, duty redefined.
